section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study examining the relationship between gender ideology and body image in 135 British female undergraduates. Participants completed the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and the Femininity Ideology Scale (FIS), with results showing significant negative correlations between body appreciation and BMI (rs -.17 to -.26), as well as between body appreciation and certain FIS subscales. The study found that Stereotypic Images and Activities and participant BMI explained 10% of the variance in body appreciation.
